<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"How do you actually tell a franchise enquiry apart from an admission enquiry at the point of contact?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Mostly through where they land. A "Become a Franchise Partner" page and a "Find a Campus" page ask different questions from the first field onward. A chatbot can also ask directly within the first exchange if the intent is not obvious yet."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is it risky to route admission leads without any further follow up on your end?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The lead is not abandoned. It is handed to the party actually equipped to act on it, immediately, with a notification confirming it landed. What stops is your team doing work that belongs to the franchisee, not the lead itself getting attention."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What does qualifying a franchise applicant actually involve?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Capital available, proposed city or territory, relevant background, sometimes a basic credit or reference check. The same seriousness you would want if you were the one deciding whether to license your name to someone."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can a franchisee see admission leads routed to their campus without seeing your franchise pipeline?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. A franchisee's access is scoped entirely to their own campus. The prospects you are currently qualifying to open new locations stay visible only to your team."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"We only have a few franchise locations right now. Is any of this premature?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The earlier this split exists, the less untangling you will need to do later. Most of the mess we get called in to fix is a franchisor whose admission handling and franchise recruitment quietly merged into one confused pipeline over a few years of growth."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Does a new franchisee's campus plug into this system automatically once they are onboarded?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. Signing triggers their territory assignment, and from that point their campus starts receiving admission leads for its area the same way every other location does."}}]}</script>

<style>
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0}
@font-face{
  font-family:'zoho-puvi';
  src:url('https://www.elitetechcorp.com/wp-content/uploads/useanyfont/6759zoho-puvi.woff2') format('woff2');
  font-weight:100 900;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;
}
.hb{
  --ground:#F9FAFB; --ground2:#F3F4F6; --white:#FFFFFF;
  --ink:#030712; --ink2:#364153; --ink3:#4A5565; --muted:#8A8A94;
  --line:#D4D4D8; --line2:#E4E4E7;
  --blue:#236EB4; --green:#3EA900; --green-d:#008236; --forest:#032E15;
  --mint:#B9F8CF; --amber:#FEF3C6; --rose:#FFE2E2; --sky:#DBEAFE;
  --grad:linear-gradient(90deg,#236EB4 0%,#3EA900 100%);
  --hl:linear-gradient(90deg,#3EA900 0%,#2E8C5A 48%,#236EB4 100%);
  --box:1200px; --gut:24px; --r:16px; --r-sm:6px; --r-lg:24px;
  --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(3,7,18,.04),0 8px 24px -12px rgba(3,7,18,.12);
  --shadow-lg:0 2px 4px rgba(3,7,18,.04),0 24px 56px -24px rgba(3,7,18,.18);
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.26,1);
  --font:'zoho-puvi','Inter',system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  font-family:var(--font);color:var(--ink2);background:var(--ground);
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
.hb *,.hb *::before,.hb *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.hb h1,.hb h2,.hb h3,.hb h4,.hb p,.hb ul,.hb ol,.hb li,.hb figure,.hb blockquote{margin:0;padding:0}
.hb h1,.hb h2,.hb h3,.hb h4{font-family:var(--font);color:#000;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:normal;line-height:1.2}
.hb a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.hb img{max-width:100%;display:block}
.hb li{list-style:none}
.hb .box{max-width:var(--box);margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:var(--gut);width:100%}
.hb .sec{position:relative;padding-block:clamp(72px,7.5vw,120px)}
.hb .sec--white{background:var(--white)}
.hb .sec--alt{background:var(--ground2)}
.hb .sec--dark{background:var(--forest);color:#DFF3E7}
.hb .sec--dark h2,.hb .sec--dark h3,.hb .sec--dark h4{color:#fff}
.hb .h1{font-size:clamp(31px,3.7vw,48px);line-height:1.16}
.hb h2{font-size:clamp(25px,2.8vw,37px);line-height:1.24}
.hb h3{font-size:clamp(19px,1.6vw,23px)}
.hb .lede{font-size:16.5px;color:#444;line-height:1.68;margin-top:16px;max-width:66ch}
.hb .sec--dark .lede{color:#CFE9D8}

/* eyebrow / labels */
.hb .eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hb .bundle-mark{display:inline-flex;gap:5px;align-items:center}
.hb .bundle-mark img{width:20px;height:20px;flex:none;object-fit:cover;object-position:left center}
.hb .bundle-mark b{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#000;margin-left:4px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.hb .sec--dark .bundle-mark b{color:#fff}
.hb .eyebrow em{font-style:normal;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:12px}
.hb .sec--dark .eyebrow em{color:#9CCFB0;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
.hb .kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 13px}
.hb .kicker--rose{color:#B91C1C;background:#FEF2F2;border:1px solid #FECACA}
.hb .kicker--green{color:var(--green-d);background:#ECFDF3;border:1px solid var(--mint)}
.hb .kicker--sky{color:#1E5A94;background:var(--sky);border:1px solid #BBD9F7}
.hb .kicker--amber{color:#8A5A14;background:var(--amber);border:1px solid #F5DDA0}

/* highlight sweep */
.hb .hl{background:var(--hl);color:#fff!important;padding:0 9px 2px;border-radius:5px;display:inline-block;line-height:1.06}
.hb.js .hl{background-size:0% 100%;background-repeat:no-repeat;color:#000!important;transition:background-size 1s var(--ease) .25s,color .4s .6s}
.hb.js .hl.in{background-size:100% 100%;color:#fff!important}

/* buttons */
.hb .btnrow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:center}
.hb .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;font-family:var(--font);font-weight:600;font-size:16px;line-height:1;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .22s var(--ease),box-shadow .22s var(--ease),background .22s}
.hb .btn i{transition:transform .22s var(--ease)}
.hb .btn:hover i{transform:translateX(3px)}
.hb .btn--g{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;border-color:#008236;box-shadow:0 8px 20px -10px rgba(35,110,180,.6)}
.hb .btn--g:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 28px -12px rgba(35,110,180,.7)}
.hb .btn--o{background:#fff;color:#000;border-color:var(--line)}
.hb .btn--o:hover{border-color:#9CA3AF;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.hb .btn--ghost{background:transparent;color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.hb .btn--ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);transform:translateY(-2px)}

/* section header block */
.hb .sec-head{max-width:760px}
.hb .sec-head.center{margin-inline:auto;text-align:center}
.hb .sec-head.center .lede{margin-inline:auto}

/* product chip */
.hb .pchip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 13px 6px 6px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line2);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .pchip img{width:22px;height:22px;object-fit:cover;object-position:left center}

/* trust counters */
.hb .stat b{display:block;font-size:clamp(34px,4vw,46px);font-weight:700;background:var(--hl);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;line-height:1}
.hb .sec--dark .stat b{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#7BE0A0,#BEE7FF);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.hb .stat b{white-space:nowrap}
.hb .stat b .count{background:inherit;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.hb .stat>span{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink3);margin-top:8px}
.hb .sec--dark .stat>span{color:#A7C7B4}

/* pattern hero ground */
.hb .patt{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#EAF1F8 0%,#EAF6EC 100%)}
.hb .patt::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-20% -5%;background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%,rgba(35,110,180,.05) 0 2px,transparent 3px),radial-gradient(circle at 70% 60%,rgba(62,169,0,.05) 0 2px,transparent 3px);background-size:60px 60px}

/* image fallbacks */
.hb .jv-media,.hb .uc-img,.hb .jf-img,.hb .pp-roi-img{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#EAF6EC 0%,#EAF1F8 100%)}
.hb .bgi{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ground2),var(--ground))}
.hb .hero-bg i{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#EAF6EC,#DBEAFE)!important}
/* footer */
.hb .foot{background:#03140B;color:#9FB9AC;padding-block:40px}
.hb .foot .box{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.hb .foot img{height:34px}
.hb .foot a{color:#CFE9D8}
.hb .foot .fr{display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:14px}

/* trust cards (contact section) */
.hb .tc-card{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:20px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s}
.hb .tc-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
.hb .tc-ic{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;font-size:18px}
.hb .tc-ic--green{background:#ECFDF3;color:var(--green-d)}
.hb .tc-card b{display:block;font-size:15px;color:#000}
.hb .tc-card span{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink3);line-height:1.45}
/* contact */
.hb .cwrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0;border-radius:var(--r-lg);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);border:1px solid var(--line2)}
.hb .cwrap .cinfo{background:var(--forest);color:#DFF3E7;padding:clamp(28px,3vw,48px)}
.hb .cwrap .cinfo h3{color:#fff}
.hb .cwrap .cform{background:#fff;padding:clamp(28px,3vw,48px)}
.hb .clist{margin-top:24px;display:grid;gap:16px}
.hb .clist li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:38px 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:start;font-size:14.5px;color:#CFE9D8}
.hb .clist .ci{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#9CCFB0}
.hb .clist b{color:#fff;display:block;font-size:14px}
.hb .clist a{color:#CFE9D8;text-decoration:underline}
.hb .wpform{border:none;border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--ground);padding:26px;min-height:320px}
.hb .wpform .code{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;display:inline-block}

/* FAQ */
.hb .qa{border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);background:#fff;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.hb .qa+.qa{margin-top:12px}
.hb .qa.open{border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .qa button{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;align-items:center;padding:22px 24px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:17px;color:#000;line-height:1.4}
.hb .qa .pm{flex:none;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);position:relative;transition:background .3s,border-color .3s}
.hb .qa .pm::before,.hb .qa .pm::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:11px;height:2px;background:var(--ink);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:transform .35s var(--ease),background .3s}
.hb .qa .pm::after{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(90deg)}
.hb .qa.open .pm{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green)}
.hb .qa.open .pm::before,.hb .qa.open .pm::after{background:#fff}
.hb .qa.open .pm::after{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(0)}
.hb .qa .ans{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .45s var(--ease)}
.hb .qa.open .ans{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.hb .qa .ans>div{overflow:hidden}
.hb .qa .ans p{padding:0 24px 24px;color:var(--ink3);font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.65}

/* testimonials: carousel */
.hb .carousel-wrap{position:relative;overflow:visible;padding:0 60px}.hb .carousel-wrap .tst-track-outer{overflow:hidden;border-radius:16px}
.hb .tst-nav{all:unset;position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line2);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;z-index:2;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:background .2s,border-color .2s}
.hb .tst-nav:hover{background:var(--ground);border-color:var(--ink3)}
.hb .tst-prev{left:0}.hb .tst-next{right:0}
.hb .tst-track{display:flex;transition:transform .45s var(--ease)}
.hb .tsc{min-width:calc(100% / 3);max-width:calc(100% / 3);flex:none;padding:0 12px;box-sizing:border-box}
.hb .tsc-inner{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:28px 24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%}
.hb .tsc__ph{width:80px;height:80px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:8px;background:#fff;margin-bottom:16px;flex:none}
.hb .tsc__ph img{max-width:100%;max-height:64px;object-fit:contain}
.hb .tsc__stars{color:#F59E0B;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:14px;display:flex;gap:2px}
.hb .tsc__stars .fa-regular{color:var(--line2)}
.hb .tsc p{color:var(--ink2);font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.65;flex:1;margin:0 0 18px;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:5;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.hb .tsc__by{font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:#000;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line2);margin-top:auto}
.hb .carousel-dots{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin-top:28px}
.hb .carousel-dot{all:unset;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line2);cursor:pointer;transition:background .3s}
.hb .carousel-dot.is-active{background:var(--blue)}

/* FAQ single column */
.hb .faqcol{max-width:840px;margin-inline:auto}

/* Overall Journey (Franchise Growth Loop) — centre-line, alternating cards */
.hb .ojourney{position:relative;margin-top:52px}
.hb .ojourney::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;bottom:70px;width:3px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--blue),var(--green));border-radius:3px}
.hb .oj-row{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 88px 1fr;align-items:center;margin-bottom:26px}
.hb .oj-node{grid-column:2;justify-self:center;width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:3px solid var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;color:var(--green-d);font-size:18px;z-index:2;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .oj-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:22px 24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);position:relative}
.hb .oj-row:nth-child(odd) .oj-card{grid-column:1;margin-right:8px}
.hb .oj-row:nth-child(even) .oj-card{grid-column:3;margin-left:8px}
.hb .oj-card h4{font-size:18px;color:#000;margin-bottom:6px}
.hb .oj-card p{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink3);line-height:1.55}
.hb .oj-apps{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-top:14px}
.hb .oj-apps .pchip{font-size:12px}.hb .oj-apps .pchip img{width:20px;height:20px;object-fit:cover;object-position:left center}
.hb .oj-tag{position:absolute;top:16px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue)}
.hb .oj-row:nth-child(odd) .oj-tag{right:24px}.hb .oj-row:nth-child(even) .oj-tag{left:24px}
.hb .oj-loop{text-align:center;margin-top:6px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.hb .oj-loop .ic{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--forest);color:#7BE0A0;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:22px;animation:spin 9s linear infinite}
.hb .oj-loop p{max-width:60ch;color:var(--ink3);font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.hb.js .oj-card,.hb.js .oj-node{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .7s var(--ease),transform .7s var(--ease)}
.hb.js .oj-node{transform:scale(.6)}
.hb.js .oj-row.in .oj-card,.hb.js .oj-row.in .oj-node{opacity:1;transform:none}
/* variant B: cards fan in from the sides */
.hb.js .ojourney--fan .oj-row:nth-child(odd) .oj-card{transform:translateX(-40px)}
.hb.js .ojourney--fan .oj-row:nth-child(even) .oj-card{transform:translateX(40px)}
.hb.js .ojourney--fan .oj-row.in .oj-card{transform:none}
/* variant C: cards tilt up */
.hb.js .ojourney--tilt .oj-card{transform:perspective(700px) rotateX(12deg) translateY(24px);transform-origin:bottom}
.hb.js .ojourney--tilt .oj-row.in .oj-card{transform:none}

/* CTA kicker (legible on dark / gradient bands) */

/* Journey A · horizontal scroll filmstrip */
.hb .jfilm{display:flex;gap:0;overflow-x:auto;padding:44px 4px 24px;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:none;-ms-overflow-style:none}

/* Journey B · vertical alternating image rows on a centre line */
.hb .jvert{position:relative;margin-top:48px}
.hb .jvert::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--blue),var(--green));border-radius:3px}

.hb .jv-media{border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);aspect-ratio:16/10}

.hb .jv-row:nth-child(odd) .jv-media{grid-column:1}.hb .jv-row:nth-child(odd) .jv-card{grid-column:3}
.hb .jv-row:nth-child(even) .jv-media{grid-column:3}.hb .jv-row:nth-child(even) .jv-card{grid-column:1;text-align:right}

.hb.js .jv-media,.hb.js .jv-card,.hb.js .jv-dot{opacity:0;transition:opacity .7s var(--ease),transform .7s var(--ease)}
.hb.js .jv-row:nth-child(odd) .jv-media{transform:translateX(-30px)}.hb.js .jv-row:nth-child(odd) .jv-card{transform:translateX(30px)}
.hb.js .jv-row:nth-child(even) .jv-media{transform:translateX(30px)}.hb.js .jv-row:nth-child(even) .jv-card{transform:translateX(-30px)}

.hb.js .jv-row.in .jv-media,.hb.js .jv-row.in .jv-card,.hb.js .jv-row.in .jv-dot{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* Journey C · bento grid of image tiles that tilt in */
.hb .jgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:48px}

/* section with an animated (ken-burns) background image behind a readable veil */

/* Zoho icon motion — gentle float across every section, hover pop */
@keyframes zfloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px)}}
.hb.js .appitem img,.hb.js .appb img,.hb.js .capp img,.hb.js .pchip img,.hb.js .tier-apps img,.hb.js .sp-apps img,.hb.js .lp img,.hb.js .loop-node img,.hb.js .mkr i{animation:zfloat 3.8s var(--ease) infinite;will-change:transform}
.hb.js .appitem:nth-child(2n) img,.hb.js .capp:nth-child(2n) img,.hb.js .appb:nth-child(2n) img,.hb.js .pchip:nth-child(2n) img{animation-delay:.5s}

.hb.js .st.in>*:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.07s}
.hb.js .st.in>*:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.14s}
.hb.js .st.in>*:nth-child(4){transition-delay:.21s}

<section class="sec sec--alt" id="faq">
  <div class="box">
    <div class="sec-head center rv" style="margin-bottom:40px"><div class="eyebrow"><span class="bundle-mark"><img src="https://www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/productlogos/social.svg" alt=""><img src="https://www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/productlogos/crm.svg" alt=""><img src="https://www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/productlogos/books.svg" alt=""><img src="https://www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/productlogos/desk.svg" alt=""><b>Elite Tech Corp</b></span><em>FAQ</em></div><h2 class="">Before you connect the loop,<br><span class="hl">the questions that come up</span></h2><p class="lede">The questions preschool franchise brands ask before they connect the loop.</p></div>
    <div class="faqcol">
      <div class="qa rv open"><button aria-expanded="true">How do you actually tell a franchise enquiry apart from an admission enquiry at the point of contact?<span class="pm"></span></button><div class="ans"><div><p>Mostly through where they land. A "Become a Franchise Partner" page and a "Find a Campus" page ask different questions from the first field onward. A chatbot can also ask directly within the first exchange if the intent is not obvious yet.</p></div></div></div><div class="qa rv"><button aria-expanded="false">Is it risky to route admission leads without any further follow up on your end?<span class="pm"></span></button><div class="ans"><div><p>The lead is not abandoned. It is handed to the party actually equipped to act on it, immediately, with a notification confirming it landed. What stops is your team doing work that belongs to the franchisee, not the lead itself getting attention.</p></div></div></div><div class="qa rv"><button aria-expanded="false">What does qualifying a franchise applicant actually involve?<span class="pm"></span></button><div class="ans"><div><p>Capital available, proposed city or territory, relevant background, sometimes a basic credit or reference check. The same seriousness you would want if you were the one deciding whether to license your name to someone.</p></div></div></div><div class="qa rv"><button aria-expanded="false">Can a franchisee see admission leads routed to their campus without seeing your franchise pipeline?<span class="pm"></span></button><div class="ans"><div><p>Yes. A franchisee's access is scoped entirely to their own campus. The prospects you are currently qualifying to open new locations stay visible only to your team.</p></div></div></div><div class="qa rv"><button aria-expanded="false">We only have a few franchise locations right now. Is any of this premature?<span class="pm"></span></button><div class="ans"><div><p>The earlier this split exists, the less untangling you will need to do later. Most of the mess we get called in to fix is a franchisor whose admission handling and franchise recruitment quietly merged into one confused pipeline over a few years of growth.</p></div></div></div><div class="qa rv"><button aria-expanded="false">Does a new franchisee's campus plug into this system automatically once they are onboarded?<span class="pm"></span></button><div class="ans"><div><p>Yes. Signing triggers their territory assignment, and from that point their campus starts receiving admission leads for its area the same way every other location does.</p></div></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
(function(){
  var reduce = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches;
  document.querySelectorAll('.hb').forEach(function(r){ if(!reduce) r.classList.add('js'); });
  var sel='.rv,.st,.eyebrow,.hl,.oj-row';
  function show(el){ el.classList.add('in'); }
  if('IntersectionObserver' in window && !reduce){
    var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){show(e.target);io.unobserve(e.target);}});},{rootMargin:'0px 0px -8% 0px',threshold:.08});
    document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(function(el){io.observe(el);});
  } else { document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(show); }
  // counters
  document.querySelectorAll('.count[data-to]').forEach(function(el){
    var done=false;
    var cio=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting && !done){done=true;
        var to=parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-to')),dec=(el.getAttribute('data-dec')||'0')|0,t0=null,dur=1400;
        (function tick(ts){if(!t0)t0=ts;var p=Math.min(1,(ts-t0)/dur);var v=to*(1-Math.pow(1-p,3));el.textContent=v.toFixed(dec);if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(tick);else el.textContent=to.toFixed(dec);})(performance.now());
        var w=el.closest('.count-wrap'); if(w)w.classList.add('in');
      }});},{threshold:.5});
    cio.observe(el);
  });
  // FAQ
  document.querySelectorAll('.qa button').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){var q=b.parentNode,o=q.classList.toggle('open');b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',o);});});
  // tabs
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-tabs]').forEach(function(g){
    var tabs=g.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]'),panels=g.querySelectorAll('[data-panel]');
    function act(name){tabs.forEach(function(t){t.classList.toggle('is-active',t.getAttribute('data-tab')===name);});panels.forEach(function(p){var on=p.getAttribute('data-panel')===name;p.hidden=!on;if(on){p.classList.remove('in');void p.offsetWidth;p.classList.add('in');}});}
    tabs.forEach(function(t){t.addEventListener('click',function(){act(t.getAttribute('data-tab'));});});
  });
  // Overall-journey filmstrip: gentle auto smooth-scroll, ping-pong, yields to the user
  if(!reduce){
    document.querySelectorAll('.jfilm').forEach(function(f){
      var dir=1, hover=false, resumeAt=0, last=performance.now();
      f.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){hover=true;});
      f.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){hover=false;});
      ['wheel','pointerdown','touchstart','keydown'].forEach(function(ev){f.addEventListener(ev,function(){resumeAt=performance.now()+3500;},{passive:true});});
      function step(ts){var dt=Math.min(64,ts-last); last=ts;
        var max=f.scrollWidth-f.clientWidth;
        if(max>4 && !hover && ts>resumeAt){
          f.scrollLeft+=dir*dt*0.05;
          if(f.scrollLeft>=max-1){dir=-1;} else if(f.scrollLeft<=0){dir=1;}
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(step);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(step);
    });
  }
  // testimonial carousel with auto-scroll
  document.querySelectorAll('.carousel-wrap').forEach(function(wrap){
    var track=wrap.querySelector('.tst-track');
    var cards=track.querySelectorAll('.tsc');
    if(!cards.length)return;
    var perPage=window.innerWidth<=760?1:3;
    var page=0, total=Math.ceil(cards.length/perPage);
    var dots=wrap.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot');
    var prev=wrap.querySelector('.tst-prev'),next=wrap.querySelector('.tst-next');
    var autoTimer=null,pauseTimer=null;
    function go(p){
      page=(p%total+total)%total;
      var cardW=cards[0].offsetWidth;
      track.style.transform='translateX(-'+(page*perPage*cardW)+'px)';
      dots.forEach(function(d,i){d.classList.toggle('is-active',i===page);});
    }
    function startAuto(){if(autoTimer)clearInterval(autoTimer);autoTimer=setInterval(function(){go(page+1);},3000);}
    function pauseAuto(){clearInterval(autoTimer);clearTimeout(pauseTimer);pauseTimer=setTimeout(startAuto,6000);}
    if(prev)prev.addEventListener('click',function(){go(page-1);pauseAuto();});
    if(next)next.addEventListener('click',function(){go(page+1);pauseAuto();});
    dots.forEach(function(d){d.addEventListener('click',function(){go(parseInt(d.getAttribute('data-slide')));pauseAuto();});});
    wrap.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){clearInterval(autoTimer);});
    wrap.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){startAuto();});
    startAuto();
  });
})();
</script>

<style>
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0}
@font-face{
  font-family:'zoho-puvi';
  src:url('https://www.elitetechcorp.com/wp-content/uploads/useanyfont/6759zoho-puvi.woff2') format('woff2');
  font-weight:100 900;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;
}
.hb{
  --ground:#F9FAFB; --ground2:#F3F4F6; --white:#FFFFFF;
  --ink:#030712; --ink2:#364153; --ink3:#4A5565; --muted:#8A8A94;
  --line:#D4D4D8; --line2:#E4E4E7;
  --blue:#236EB4; --green:#3EA900; --green-d:#008236; --forest:#032E15;
  --mint:#B9F8CF; --amber:#FEF3C6; --rose:#FFE2E2; --sky:#DBEAFE;
  --grad:linear-gradient(90deg,#236EB4 0%,#3EA900 100%);
  --hl:linear-gradient(90deg,#3EA900 0%,#2E8C5A 48%,#236EB4 100%);
  --box:1200px; --gut:24px; --r:16px; --r-sm:6px; --r-lg:24px;
  --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(3,7,18,.04),0 8px 24px -12px rgba(3,7,18,.12);
  --shadow-lg:0 2px 4px rgba(3,7,18,.04),0 24px 56px -24px rgba(3,7,18,.18);
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.26,1);
  --font:'zoho-puvi','Inter',system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  font-family:var(--font);color:var(--ink2);background:var(--ground);
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
.hb *,.hb *::before,.hb *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.hb h1,.hb h2,.hb h3,.hb h4,.hb p,.hb ul,.hb ol,.hb li,.hb figure,.hb blockquote{margin:0;padding:0}
.hb h1,.hb h2,.hb h3,.hb h4{font-family:var(--font);color:#000;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:normal;line-height:1.2}
.hb a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.hb img{max-width:100%;display:block}
.hb li{list-style:none}
.hb .box{max-width:var(--box);margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:var(--gut);width:100%}
.hb .sec{position:relative;padding-block:clamp(72px,7.5vw,120px)}
.hb .sec--white{background:var(--white)}
.hb .sec--alt{background:var(--ground2)}
.hb .sec--dark{background:var(--forest);color:#DFF3E7}
.hb .sec--dark h2,.hb .sec--dark h3,.hb .sec--dark h4{color:#fff}
.hb .h1{font-size:clamp(31px,3.7vw,48px);line-height:1.16}
.hb h2{font-size:clamp(25px,2.8vw,37px);line-height:1.24}
.hb h3{font-size:clamp(19px,1.6vw,23px)}
.hb .lede{font-size:16.5px;color:#444;line-height:1.68;margin-top:16px;max-width:66ch}
.hb .sec--dark .lede{color:#CFE9D8}

/* eyebrow / labels */
.hb .eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hb .bundle-mark{display:inline-flex;gap:5px;align-items:center}
.hb .bundle-mark img{width:20px;height:20px;flex:none;object-fit:cover;object-position:left center}
.hb .bundle-mark b{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#000;margin-left:4px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.hb .sec--dark .bundle-mark b{color:#fff}
.hb .eyebrow em{font-style:normal;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:12px}
.hb .sec--dark .eyebrow em{color:#9CCFB0;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
.hb .kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 13px}
.hb .kicker--rose{color:#B91C1C;background:#FEF2F2;border:1px solid #FECACA}
.hb .kicker--green{color:var(--green-d);background:#ECFDF3;border:1px solid var(--mint)}
.hb .kicker--sky{color:#1E5A94;background:var(--sky);border:1px solid #BBD9F7}
.hb .kicker--amber{color:#8A5A14;background:var(--amber);border:1px solid #F5DDA0}

/* highlight sweep */
.hb .hl{background:var(--hl);color:#fff!important;padding:0 9px 2px;border-radius:5px;display:inline-block;line-height:1.06}
.hb.js .hl{background-size:0% 100%;background-repeat:no-repeat;color:#000!important;transition:background-size 1s var(--ease) .25s,color .4s .6s}
.hb.js .hl.in{background-size:100% 100%;color:#fff!important}

/* buttons */
.hb .btnrow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:center}
.hb .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;font-family:var(--font);font-weight:600;font-size:16px;line-height:1;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .22s var(--ease),box-shadow .22s var(--ease),background .22s}
.hb .btn i{transition:transform .22s var(--ease)}
.hb .btn:hover i{transform:translateX(3px)}
.hb .btn--g{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;border-color:#008236;box-shadow:0 8px 20px -10px rgba(35,110,180,.6)}
.hb .btn--g:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 28px -12px rgba(35,110,180,.7)}
.hb .btn--o{background:#fff;color:#000;border-color:var(--line)}
.hb .btn--o:hover{border-color:#9CA3AF;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.hb .btn--ghost{background:transparent;color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.hb .btn--ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);transform:translateY(-2px)}

/* section header block */
.hb .sec-head{max-width:760px}
.hb .sec-head.center{margin-inline:auto;text-align:center}
.hb .sec-head.center .lede{margin-inline:auto}

/* product chip */
.hb .pchip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 13px 6px 6px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line2);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .pchip img{width:22px;height:22px;object-fit:cover;object-position:left center}

/* trust counters */
.hb .stat b{display:block;font-size:clamp(34px,4vw,46px);font-weight:700;background:var(--hl);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;line-height:1}
.hb .sec--dark .stat b{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#7BE0A0,#BEE7FF);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.hb .stat b{white-space:nowrap}
.hb .stat b .count{background:inherit;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.hb .stat>span{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink3);margin-top:8px}
.hb .sec--dark .stat>span{color:#A7C7B4}

/* pattern hero ground */
.hb .patt{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#EAF1F8 0%,#EAF6EC 100%)}
.hb .patt::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-20% -5%;background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%,rgba(35,110,180,.05) 0 2px,transparent 3px),radial-gradient(circle at 70% 60%,rgba(62,169,0,.05) 0 2px,transparent 3px);background-size:60px 60px}

/* image fallbacks */
.hb .jv-media,.hb .uc-img,.hb .jf-img,.hb .pp-roi-img{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#EAF6EC 0%,#EAF1F8 100%)}
.hb .bgi{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ground2),var(--ground))}
.hb .hero-bg i{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#EAF6EC,#DBEAFE)!important}
/* footer */
.hb .foot{background:#03140B;color:#9FB9AC;padding-block:40px}
.hb .foot .box{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.hb .foot img{height:34px}
.hb .foot a{color:#CFE9D8}
.hb .foot .fr{display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:14px}

/* trust cards (contact section) */
.hb .tc-card{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:20px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s}
.hb .tc-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
.hb .tc-ic{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;font-size:18px}
.hb .tc-ic--green{background:#ECFDF3;color:var(--green-d)}
.hb .tc-card b{display:block;font-size:15px;color:#000}
.hb .tc-card span{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink3);line-height:1.45}
/* contact */
.hb .cwrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0;border-radius:var(--r-lg);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);border:1px solid var(--line2)}
.hb .cwrap .cinfo{background:var(--forest);color:#DFF3E7;padding:clamp(28px,3vw,48px)}
.hb .cwrap .cinfo h3{color:#fff}
.hb .cwrap .cform{background:#fff;padding:clamp(28px,3vw,48px)}
.hb .clist{margin-top:24px;display:grid;gap:16px}
.hb .clist li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:38px 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:start;font-size:14.5px;color:#CFE9D8}
.hb .clist .ci{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#9CCFB0}
.hb .clist b{color:#fff;display:block;font-size:14px}
.hb .clist a{color:#CFE9D8;text-decoration:underline}
.hb .wpform{border:none;border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--ground);padding:26px;min-height:320px}
.hb .wpform .code{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;display:inline-block}

/* FAQ */
.hb .qa{border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);background:#fff;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.hb .qa+.qa{margin-top:12px}
.hb .qa.open{border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .qa button{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;align-items:center;padding:22px 24px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:17px;color:#000;line-height:1.4}
.hb .qa .pm{flex:none;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);position:relative;transition:background .3s,border-color .3s}
.hb .qa .pm::before,.hb .qa .pm::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:11px;height:2px;background:var(--ink);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:transform .35s var(--ease),background .3s}
.hb .qa .pm::after{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(90deg)}
.hb .qa.open .pm{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green)}
.hb .qa.open .pm::before,.hb .qa.open .pm::after{background:#fff}
.hb .qa.open .pm::after{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(0)}
.hb .qa .ans{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .45s var(--ease)}
.hb .qa.open .ans{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.hb .qa .ans>div{overflow:hidden}
.hb .qa .ans p{padding:0 24px 24px;color:var(--ink3);font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.65}

/* testimonials: carousel */
.hb .carousel-wrap{position:relative;overflow:visible;padding:0 60px}.hb .carousel-wrap .tst-track-outer{overflow:hidden;border-radius:16px}
.hb .tst-nav{all:unset;position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line2);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;z-index:2;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:background .2s,border-color .2s}
.hb .tst-nav:hover{background:var(--ground);border-color:var(--ink3)}
.hb .tst-prev{left:0}.hb .tst-next{right:0}
.hb .tst-track{display:flex;transition:transform .45s var(--ease)}
.hb .tsc{min-width:calc(100% / 3);max-width:calc(100% / 3);flex:none;padding:0 12px;box-sizing:border-box}
.hb .tsc-inner{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:28px 24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%}
.hb .tsc__ph{width:80px;height:80px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:8px;background:#fff;margin-bottom:16px;flex:none}
.hb .tsc__ph img{max-width:100%;max-height:64px;object-fit:contain}
.hb .tsc__stars{color:#F59E0B;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:14px;display:flex;gap:2px}
.hb .tsc__stars .fa-regular{color:var(--line2)}
.hb .tsc p{color:var(--ink2);font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.65;flex:1;margin:0 0 18px;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:5;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.hb .tsc__by{font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:#000;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line2);margin-top:auto}
.hb .carousel-dots{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin-top:28px}
.hb .carousel-dot{all:unset;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line2);cursor:pointer;transition:background .3s}
.hb .carousel-dot.is-active{background:var(--blue)}

/* FAQ single column */
.hb .faqcol{max-width:840px;margin-inline:auto}

/* Overall Journey (Franchise Growth Loop) — centre-line, alternating cards */
.hb .ojourney{position:relative;margin-top:52px}
.hb .ojourney::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;bottom:70px;width:3px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--blue),var(--green));border-radius:3px}
.hb .oj-row{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 88px 1fr;align-items:center;margin-bottom:26px}
.hb .oj-node{grid-column:2;justify-self:center;width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:3px solid var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;color:var(--green-d);font-size:18px;z-index:2;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .oj-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:22px 24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);position:relative}
.hb .oj-row:nth-child(odd) .oj-card{grid-column:1;margin-right:8px}
.hb .oj-row:nth-child(even) .oj-card{grid-column:3;margin-left:8px}
.hb .oj-card h4{font-size:18px;color:#000;margin-bottom:6px}
.hb .oj-card p{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink3);line-height:1.55}
.hb .oj-apps{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-top:14px}
.hb .oj-apps .pchip{font-size:12px}.hb .oj-apps .pchip img{width:20px;height:20px}
.hb .oj-tag{position:absolute;top:16px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue)}
.hb .oj-row:nth-child(odd) .oj-tag{right:24px}.hb .oj-row:nth-child(even) .oj-tag{left:24px}
.hb .oj-loop{text-align:center;margin-top:6px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.hb .oj-loop .ic{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--forest);color:#7BE0A0;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:22px;animation:spin 9s linear infinite}
.hb .oj-loop p{max-width:60ch;color:var(--ink3);font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.hb.js .oj-card,.hb.js .oj-node{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .7s var(--ease),transform .7s var(--ease)}
.hb.js .oj-node{transform:scale(.6)}
.hb.js .oj-row.in .oj-card,.hb.js .oj-row.in .oj-node{opacity:1;transform:none}
/* variant B: cards fan in from the sides */
.hb.js .ojourney--fan .oj-row:nth-child(odd) .oj-card{transform:translateX(-40px)}
.hb.js .ojourney--fan .oj-row:nth-child(even) .oj-card{transform:translateX(40px)}
.hb.js .ojourney--fan .oj-row.in .oj-card{transform:none}
/* variant C: cards tilt up */
.hb.js .ojourney--tilt .oj-card{transform:perspective(700px) rotateX(12deg) translateY(24px);transform-origin:bottom}
.hb.js .ojourney--tilt .oj-row.in .oj-card{transform:none}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .hb .ojourney::before{left:26px}
  .hb .oj-row{grid-template-columns:52px 1fr;gap:14px}
  .hb .oj-node{grid-column:1;width:52px;height:52px}
  .hb .oj-row:nth-child(odd) .oj-card,.hb .oj-row:nth-child(even) .oj-card{grid-column:2;margin:0}
  .hb .oj-tag{position:static;display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
  .hb .carousel-wrap{padding:0 52px}
  .hb .tsc{min-width:100%;max-width:100%}
  .hb .tst-nav{width:36px;height:36px;font-size:12px}
  .hb .tst-prev{left:0}.hb .tst-next{right:0}
}

/* CTA kicker (legible on dark / gradient bands) */
.hb .cta-kick{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#EAFBF1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px;margin-bottom:16px}
.hb .cta-kick i{color:#9EE7B8}
.hb .cta-kick--solid{color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}

/* Journey shared close */
.hb .jloop{margin-top:34px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:center}
.hb .jloop .ic{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--forest);color:#7BE0A0;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:21px;animation:spin 9s linear infinite}
.hb .jloop p{max-width:60ch;color:var(--ink3);font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.hb .oj-apps{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-top:14px}
.hb .oj-apps .pchip{font-size:12px}.hb .oj-apps .pchip img{width:20px;height:20px}
.hb .oj-tag{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:6px}

/* Journey A · horizontal scroll filmstrip */
.hb .jfilm{display:flex;gap:0;overflow-x:auto;padding:44px 4px 24px;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:none;-ms-overflow-style:none}
.hb .jfilm::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.hb .jf-card{scroll-snap-align:center;flex:0 0 300px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .jf-img{position:relative;height:150px}
.hb .jf-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.hb .jf-n{position:absolute;left:14px;top:14px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:15px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .jf-body{padding:20px 22px}
.hb .jf-body h4{font-size:18px;color:#000;margin-bottom:6px}
.hb .jf-body p{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink3);line-height:1.5}
.hb .jf-arrow{flex:0 0 46px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--green);font-size:20px}
.hb .jf-hint{text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}

/* Journey B · vertical alternating image rows on a centre line */
.hb .jvert{position:relative;margin-top:48px}
.hb .jvert::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--blue),var(--green));border-radius:3px}
.hb .jv-row{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 70px 1fr;align-items:center;margin-bottom:30px}
.hb .jv-dot{grid-column:2;justify-self:center;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:3px solid var(--green);color:var(--green-d);font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center;z-index:2;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .jv-media{border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);aspect-ratio:16/10}
.hb .jv-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}
.hb .jv-row:hover .jv-media img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.hb .jv-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:22px 24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .jv-row:nth-child(odd) .jv-media{grid-column:1}.hb .jv-row:nth-child(odd) .jv-card{grid-column:3}
.hb .jv-row:nth-child(even) .jv-media{grid-column:3}.hb .jv-row:nth-child(even) .jv-card{grid-column:1;text-align:right}
.hb .jv-row:nth-child(even) .oj-apps{justify-content:flex-end}
.hb .jv-card h4{font-size:19px;color:#000;margin-bottom:6px}
.hb .jv-card p{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink3);line-height:1.55}
.hb.js .jv-media,.hb.js .jv-card,.hb.js .jv-dot{opacity:0;transition:opacity .7s var(--ease),transform .7s var(--ease)}
.hb.js .jv-row:nth-child(odd) .jv-media{transform:translateX(-30px)}.hb.js .jv-row:nth-child(odd) .jv-card{transform:translateX(30px)}
.hb.js .jv-row:nth-child(even) .jv-media{transform:translateX(30px)}.hb.js .jv-row:nth-child(even) .jv-card{transform:translateX(-30px)}
.hb.js .jv-dot{transform:scale(.6)}
.hb.js .jv-row.in .jv-media,.hb.js .jv-row.in .jv-card,.hb.js .jv-row.in .jv-dot{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* Journey C · bento grid of image tiles that tilt in */
.hb .jgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:48px}
.hb .jg-tile{position:relative;border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;min-height:250px;display:flex;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .jg-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.3s var(--ease)}
.hb .jg-tile:hover .jg-bg{transform:scale(1.08)}
.hb .jg-shade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(3,20,11,.15),rgba(3,20,11,.86))}
.hb .jg-in{position:relative;margin-top:auto;padding:22px;color:#fff;z-index:2}
.hb .jg-n{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#9EE7B8}
.hb .jg-in h4{color:#fff;font-size:19px;margin:5px 0 6px}
.hb .jg-in p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.5}
.hb .jg-apps{display:flex;gap:7px;margin-top:12px}
.hb .jg-apps img{width:30px;height:30px;background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:4px;object-fit:cover;object-position:left center}
.hb.js .jgrid.st>*{transform:perspective(800px) rotateX(14deg) translateY(26px);transform-origin:bottom}
.hb.js .jgrid.st.in>*{transform:none}
@media(max-width:860px){.hb .jgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .hb .jvert::before{left:26px}
  .hb .jv-row{grid-template-columns:52px 1fr;gap:14px}
  .hb .jv-dot{grid-column:1}
  .hb .jv-row .jv-media,.hb .jv-row .jv-card{grid-column:2!important;text-align:left!important}
  .hb .jv-row .oj-apps{justify-content:flex-start!important}
  .hb .jv-media{margin-bottom:12px}
}
@media(max-width:520px){.hb .jgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hb .jf-card{flex-basis:80%}}

/* Comparison A · versus rows */
.hb .vs{margin-top:44px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r-lg);overflow:hidden;background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .vs-head,.hb .vs-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:0}
.hb .vs-head span{padding:16px 22px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);background:var(--ground)}
.hb .vs-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.hb .vs-h--us{background:var(--forest)!important;color:#fff!important}
.hb .vs-h--us img{height:18px;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 4px}
.hb .vs-row{border-top:1px solid var(--line2)}
.hb .vs-topic{padding:18px 22px;font-weight:700;color:#000;font-size:15px}
.hb .vs-cell{padding:18px 22px;font-size:14.5px;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;line-height:1.45}
.hb .vs-cell i{margin-top:3px;flex:none}
.hb .vs-us{background:#F2FBF4;color:#0A3D22}.hb .vs-us i{color:var(--green)}
.hb .vs-them{color:var(--muted)}.hb .vs-them i{color:#B91C1C}
@media(max-width:760px){.hb .vs-head{display:none}.hb .vs-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hb .vs-topic{background:var(--ground)}}

/* Comparison B · scoreboard strip above the columns */
.hb .scoreboard{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin:44px 0 6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hb .sb{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;border-radius:var(--r);padding:16px 24px;border:1px solid var(--line2);background:#fff}
.hb .sb b{font-family:var(--font);font-size:30px;font-weight:800}
.hb .sb.sb--us{background:var(--forest);border-color:var(--forest);color:#fff}
.hb .sb.sb--us b{color:#7BE0A0}
.hb .sb small{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink3)}.hb .sb--us small{color:#CFE9D8}
.hb .sb-vs{font-weight:800;color:var(--muted)}

/* CTA band (shared by design-1 landing and all product pages) */
.hb .ctaband{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--r-lg);min-height:400px;display:flex;align-items:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
.hb .ctaband>img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.hb .ctaband::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(3,46,21,.95),rgba(3,46,21,.7) 55%,rgba(3,46,21,.28))}
.hb .ctaband .in{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:clamp(30px,4vw,60px);max-width:640px;color:#fff}
.hb .ctaband .in.box{max-width:var(--box)}
.hb .ctaband h2{color:#fff}
.hb .ctaband p{color:#CFE9D8;margin-top:14px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6}

/* full-bleed CTA */
.hb .cta-sec{padding:0}
.hb .cta-full{position:relative;left:50%;right:50%;margin-left:-50vw;margin-right:-50vw;width:100vw;max-width:100vw;border-radius:0!important}
.hb .cta-full .box{padding-block:clamp(46px,5.5vw,82px)}
.hb .ctaband.cta-full .in.box{max-width:var(--box)}
.hb .ctaband.cta-full .in.box p{max-width:560px}
/* CTA content centred on every page (image-backed band uses a symmetric veil) */
.hb .ctaband.cta-full{justify-content:center;text-align:center}
.hb .ctaband.cta-full::after{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(3,46,21,.86),rgba(3,46,21,.74))}
.hb .ctaband.cta-full .in.box{margin-inline:auto;max-width:900px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.hb .ctaband.cta-full .in.box p{max-width:640px;margin-inline:auto}
.hb .ctaband.cta-full .btnrow,.hb .ctadark .btnrow,.hb .ctgrad .btnrow{justify-content:center}
.hb .pp-others{justify-content:center}

/* section with an animated (ken-burns) background image behind a readable veil */
@keyframes bgZoom{from{transform:scale(1.04)}to{transform:scale(1.16)}}
.hb .sec--bgimg{position:relative;isolation:isolate}
.hb .sec--bgimg>.bgi{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;overflow:hidden}
.hb .sec--bgimg>.bgi img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;animation:bgZoom 36s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.hb .sec--bgimg::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(243,244,246,.94),rgba(240,247,241,.9))}
.hb .sec--bgimg.sec--white::after{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.95),rgba(248,251,249,.92))}

<script>
(function(){
  var reduce = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches;
  document.querySelectorAll('.hb').forEach(function(r){ if(!reduce) r.classList.add('js'); });
  var sel='.rv,.st,.eyebrow,.hl,.oj-row';
  function show(el){ el.classList.add('in'); }
  if('IntersectionObserver' in window && !reduce){
    var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){show(e.target);io.unobserve(e.target);}});},{rootMargin:'0px 0px -8% 0px',threshold:.08});
    document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(function(el){io.observe(el);});
  } else { document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(show); }
  // counters
  document.querySelectorAll('.count[data-to]').forEach(function(el){
    var done=false;
    var cio=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting && !done){done=true;
        var to=parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-to')),dec=(el.getAttribute('data-dec')||'0')|0,t0=null,dur=1400;
        (function tick(ts){if(!t0)t0=ts;var p=Math.min(1,(ts-t0)/dur);var v=to*(1-Math.pow(1-p,3));el.textContent=v.toFixed(dec);if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(tick);else el.textContent=to.toFixed(dec);})(performance.now());
        var w=el.closest('.count-wrap'); if(w)w.classList.add('in');
      }});},{threshold:.5});
    cio.observe(el);
  });
  // FAQ
  document.querySelectorAll('.qa button').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){var q=b.parentNode,o=q.classList.toggle('open');b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',o);});});
  // tabs
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-tabs]').forEach(function(g){
    var tabs=g.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]'),panels=g.querySelectorAll('[data-panel]');
    function act(name){tabs.forEach(function(t){t.classList.toggle('is-active',t.getAttribute('data-tab')===name);});panels.forEach(function(p){var on=p.getAttribute('data-panel')===name;p.hidden=!on;if(on){p.classList.remove('in');void p.offsetWidth;p.classList.add('in');}});}
    tabs.forEach(function(t){t.addEventListener('click',function(){act(t.getAttribute('data-tab'));});});
  });
  // Overall-journey filmstrip: gentle auto smooth-scroll, ping-pong, yields to the user
  if(!reduce){
    document.querySelectorAll('.jfilm').forEach(function(f){
      var dir=1, hover=false, resumeAt=0, last=performance.now();
      f.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){hover=true;});
      f.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){hover=false;});
      ['wheel','pointerdown','touchstart','keydown'].forEach(function(ev){f.addEventListener(ev,function(){resumeAt=performance.now()+3500;},{passive:true});});
      function step(ts){var dt=Math.min(64,ts-last); last=ts;
        var max=f.scrollWidth-f.clientWidth;
        if(max>4 && !hover && ts>resumeAt){
          f.scrollLeft+=dir*dt*0.05;
          if(f.scrollLeft>=max-1){dir=-1;} else if(f.scrollLeft<=0){dir=1;}
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(step);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(step);
    });
  }
  // testimonial carousel with auto-scroll
  document.querySelectorAll('.carousel-wrap').forEach(function(wrap){
    var track=wrap.querySelector('.tst-track');
    var cards=track.querySelectorAll('.tsc');
    if(!cards.length)return;
    var perPage=window.innerWidth<=760?1:3;
    var page=0, total=Math.ceil(cards.length/perPage);
    var dots=wrap.querySelectorAll('.carousel-dot');
    var prev=wrap.querySelector('.tst-prev'),next=wrap.querySelector('.tst-next');
    var autoTimer=null,pauseTimer=null;
    function go(p){
      page=(p%total+total)%total;
      var cardW=cards[0].offsetWidth;
      track.style.transform='translateX(-'+(page*perPage*cardW)+'px)';
      dots.forEach(function(d,i){d.classList.toggle('is-active',i===page);});
    }
    function startAuto(){if(autoTimer)clearInterval(autoTimer);autoTimer=setInterval(function(){go(page+1);},3000);}
    function pauseAuto(){clearInterval(autoTimer);clearTimeout(pauseTimer);pauseTimer=setTimeout(startAuto,6000);}
    if(prev)prev.addEventListener('click',function(){go(page-1);pauseAuto();});
    if(next)next.addEventListener('click',function(){go(page+1);pauseAuto();});
    dots.forEach(function(d){d.addEventListener('click',function(){go(parseInt(d.getAttribute('data-slide')));pauseAuto();});});
    wrap.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){clearInterval(autoTimer);});
    wrap.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){startAuto();});
    startAuto();
  });
})();
</script>

<style>
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0}
@font-face{
  font-family:'zoho-puvi';
  src:url('https://www.elitetechcorp.com/wp-content/uploads/useanyfont/6759zoho-puvi.woff2') format('woff2');
  font-weight:100 900;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;
}
.hb{
  --ground:#F9FAFB; --ground2:#F3F4F6; --white:#FFFFFF;
  --ink:#030712; --ink2:#364153; --ink3:#4A5565; --muted:#8A8A94;
  --line:#D4D4D8; --line2:#E4E4E7;
  --blue:#236EB4; --green:#3EA900; --green-d:#008236; --forest:#032E15;
  --mint:#B9F8CF; --amber:#FEF3C6; --rose:#FFE2E2; --sky:#DBEAFE;
  --grad:linear-gradient(90deg,#236EB4 0%,#3EA900 100%);
  --hl:linear-gradient(90deg,#3EA900 0%,#2E8C5A 48%,#236EB4 100%);
  --box:1200px; --gut:24px; --r:16px; --r-sm:6px; --r-lg:24px;
  --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(3,7,18,.04),0 8px 24px -12px rgba(3,7,18,.12);
  --shadow-lg:0 2px 4px rgba(3,7,18,.04),0 24px 56px -24px rgba(3,7,18,.18);
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,.75,.26,1);
  --font:'zoho-puvi','Inter',system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  font-family:var(--font);color:var(--ink2);background:var(--ground);
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
.hb *,.hb *::before,.hb *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
.hb h1,.hb h2,.hb h3,.hb h4,.hb p,.hb ul,.hb ol,.hb li,.hb figure,.hb blockquote{margin:0;padding:0}
.hb h1,.hb h2,.hb h3,.hb h4{font-family:var(--font);color:#000;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:normal;line-height:1.2}
.hb a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.hb img{max-width:100%;display:block}
.hb li{list-style:none}
.hb .box{max-width:var(--box);margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:var(--gut);width:100%}
.hb .sec{position:relative;padding-block:clamp(72px,7.5vw,120px)}
.hb .sec--white{background:var(--white)}
.hb .sec--alt{background:var(--ground2)}
.hb .sec--dark{background:var(--forest);color:#DFF3E7}
.hb .sec--dark h2,.hb .sec--dark h3,.hb .sec--dark h4{color:#fff}
.hb .h1{font-size:clamp(31px,3.7vw,48px);line-height:1.16}
.hb h2{font-size:clamp(25px,2.8vw,37px);line-height:1.24}
.hb h3{font-size:clamp(19px,1.6vw,23px)}
.hb .lede{font-size:16.5px;color:#444;line-height:1.68;margin-top:16px;max-width:66ch}
.hb .sec--dark .lede{color:#CFE9D8}

/* eyebrow / labels */
.hb .eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hb .bundle-mark{display:inline-flex;gap:5px;align-items:center}
.hb .bundle-mark img{width:20px;height:20px;flex:none;object-fit:cover;object-position:left center}
.hb .bundle-mark b{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#000;margin-left:4px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.hb .sec--dark .bundle-mark b{color:#fff}
.hb .eyebrow em{font-style:normal;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:12px}
.hb .sec--dark .eyebrow em{color:#9CCFB0;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
.hb .kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 13px}
.hb .kicker--rose{color:#B91C1C;background:#FEF2F2;border:1px solid #FECACA}
.hb .kicker--green{color:var(--green-d);background:#ECFDF3;border:1px solid var(--mint)}
.hb .kicker--sky{color:#1E5A94;background:var(--sky);border:1px solid #BBD9F7}
.hb .kicker--amber{color:#8A5A14;background:var(--amber);border:1px solid #F5DDA0}

/* highlight sweep */
.hb .hl{background:var(--hl);color:#fff!important;padding:0 9px 2px;border-radius:5px;display:inline-block;line-height:1.06}
.hb.js .hl{background-size:0% 100%;background-repeat:no-repeat;color:#000!important;transition:background-size 1s var(--ease) .25s,color .4s .6s}
.hb.js .hl.in{background-size:100% 100%;color:#fff!important}

/* buttons */
.hb .btnrow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:center}
.hb .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;font-family:var(--font);font-weight:600;font-size:16px;line-height:1;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .22s var(--ease),box-shadow .22s var(--ease),background .22s}
.hb .btn i{transition:transform .22s var(--ease)}
.hb .btn:hover i{transform:translateX(3px)}
.hb .btn--g{background:var(--grad);color:#fff;border-color:#008236;box-shadow:0 8px 20px -10px rgba(35,110,180,.6)}
.hb .btn--g:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 14px 28px -12px rgba(35,110,180,.7)}
.hb .btn--o{background:#fff;color:#000;border-color:var(--line)}
.hb .btn--o:hover{border-color:#9CA3AF;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.hb .btn--ghost{background:transparent;color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.hb .btn--ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);transform:translateY(-2px)}

/* section header block */
.hb .sec-head{max-width:760px}
.hb .sec-head.center{margin-inline:auto;text-align:center}
.hb .sec-head.center .lede{margin-inline:auto}

/* product chip */
.hb .pchip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 13px 6px 6px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line2);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .pchip img{width:22px;height:22px;object-fit:cover;object-position:left center}

/* trust counters */
.hb .stat b{display:block;font-size:clamp(34px,4vw,46px);font-weight:700;background:var(--hl);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;line-height:1}
.hb .sec--dark .stat b{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#7BE0A0,#BEE7FF);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.hb .stat b{white-space:nowrap}
.hb .stat b .count{background:inherit;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.hb .stat>span{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink3);margin-top:8px}
.hb .sec--dark .stat>span{color:#A7C7B4}

/* pattern hero ground */
.hb .patt{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#EAF1F8 0%,#EAF6EC 100%)}
.hb .patt::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-20% -5%;background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%,rgba(35,110,180,.05) 0 2px,transparent 3px),radial-gradient(circle at 70% 60%,rgba(62,169,0,.05) 0 2px,transparent 3px);background-size:60px 60px}

/* image fallbacks */
.hb .jv-media,.hb .uc-img,.hb .jf-img,.hb .pp-roi-img{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#EAF6EC 0%,#EAF1F8 100%)}
.hb .bgi{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ground2),var(--ground))}
.hb .hero-bg i{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#EAF6EC,#DBEAFE)!important}
/* footer */
.hb .foot{background:#03140B;color:#9FB9AC;padding-block:40px}
.hb .foot .box{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.hb .foot img{height:34px}
.hb .foot a{color:#CFE9D8}
.hb .foot .fr{display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:14px}

/* trust cards (contact section) */
.hb .tc-card{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:20px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s}
.hb .tc-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
.hb .tc-ic{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;font-size:18px}
.hb .tc-ic--green{background:#ECFDF3;color:var(--green-d)}
.hb .tc-card b{display:block;font-size:15px;color:#000}
.hb .tc-card span{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink3);line-height:1.45}
/* contact */
.hb .cwrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0;border-radius:var(--r-lg);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);border:1px solid var(--line2)}
.hb .cwrap .cinfo{background:var(--forest);color:#DFF3E7;padding:clamp(28px,3vw,48px)}
.hb .cwrap .cinfo h3{color:#fff}
.hb .cwrap .cform{background:#fff;padding:clamp(28px,3vw,48px)}
.hb .clist{margin-top:24px;display:grid;gap:16px}
.hb .clist li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:38px 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:start;font-size:14.5px;color:#CFE9D8}
.hb .clist .ci{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#9CCFB0}
.hb .clist b{color:#fff;display:block;font-size:14px}
.hb .clist a{color:#CFE9D8;text-decoration:underline}
.hb .wpform{border:none;border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--ground);padding:26px;min-height:320px}
.hb .wpform .code{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;display:inline-block}

/* FAQ */
.hb .qa{border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);background:#fff;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.hb .qa+.qa{margin-top:12px}
.hb .qa.open{border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .qa button{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;align-items:center;padding:22px 24px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:17px;color:#000;line-height:1.4}
.hb .qa .pm{flex:none;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);position:relative;transition:background .3s,border-color .3s}
.hb .qa .pm::before,.hb .qa .pm::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:11px;height:2px;background:var(--ink);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:transform .35s var(--ease),background .3s}
.hb .qa .pm::after{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(90deg)}
.hb .qa.open .pm{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green)}
.hb .qa.open .pm::before,.hb .qa.open .pm::after{background:#fff}
.hb .qa.open .pm::after{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(0)}
.hb .qa .ans{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .45s var(--ease)}
.hb .qa.open .ans{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.hb .qa .ans>div{overflow:hidden}
.hb .qa .ans p{padding:0 24px 24px;color:var(--ink3);font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.65}

/* testimonials: carousel */
.hb .carousel-wrap{position:relative;overflow:visible;padding:0 60px}.hb .carousel-wrap .tst-track-outer{overflow:hidden;border-radius:16px}
.hb .tst-nav{all:unset;position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line2);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;z-index:2;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:background .2s,border-color .2s}
.hb .tst-nav:hover{background:var(--ground);border-color:var(--ink3)}
.hb .tst-prev{left:0}.hb .tst-next{right:0}
.hb .tst-track{display:flex;transition:transform .45s var(--ease)}
.hb .tsc{min-width:calc(100% / 3);max-width:calc(100% / 3);flex:none;padding:0 12px;box-sizing:border-box}
.hb .tsc-inner{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:28px 24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%}
.hb .tsc__ph{width:80px;height:80px;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:8px;background:#fff;margin-bottom:16px;flex:none}
.hb .tsc__ph img{max-width:100%;max-height:64px;object-fit:contain}
.hb .tsc__stars{color:#F59E0B;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:14px;display:flex;gap:2px}
.hb .tsc__stars .fa-regular{color:var(--line2)}
.hb .tsc p{color:var(--ink2);font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.65;flex:1;margin:0 0 18px;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:5;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.hb .tsc__by{font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:#000;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line2);margin-top:auto}
.hb .carousel-dots{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px;margin-top:28px}
.hb .carousel-dot{all:unset;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line2);cursor:pointer;transition:background .3s}
.hb .carousel-dot.is-active{background:var(--blue)}

/* FAQ single column */
.hb .faqcol{max-width:840px;margin-inline:auto}

/* Overall Journey (Franchise Growth Loop) — centre-line, alternating cards */
.hb .ojourney{position:relative;margin-top:52px}
.hb .ojourney::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;bottom:70px;width:3px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--blue),var(--green));border-radius:3px}
.hb .oj-row{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 88px 1fr;align-items:center;margin-bottom:26px}
.hb .oj-node{grid-column:2;justify-self:center;width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:3px solid var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:800;color:var(--green-d);font-size:18px;z-index:2;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .oj-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:22px 24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);position:relative}
.hb .oj-row:nth-child(odd) .oj-card{grid-column:1;margin-right:8px}
.hb .oj-row:nth-child(even) .oj-card{grid-column:3;margin-left:8px}
.hb .oj-card h4{font-size:18px;color:#000;margin-bottom:6px}
.hb .oj-card p{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink3);line-height:1.55}
.hb .oj-apps{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-top:14px}
.hb .oj-apps .pchip{font-size:12px}.hb .oj-apps .pchip img{width:20px;height:20px}
.hb .oj-tag{position:absolute;top:16px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue)}
.hb .oj-row:nth-child(odd) .oj-tag{right:24px}.hb .oj-row:nth-child(even) .oj-tag{left:24px}
.hb .oj-loop{text-align:center;margin-top:6px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.hb .oj-loop .ic{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--forest);color:#7BE0A0;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:22px;animation:spin 9s linear infinite}
.hb .oj-loop p{max-width:60ch;color:var(--ink3);font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.hb.js .oj-card,.hb.js .oj-node{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .7s var(--ease),transform .7s var(--ease)}
.hb.js .oj-node{transform:scale(.6)}
.hb.js .oj-row.in .oj-card,.hb.js .oj-row.in .oj-node{opacity:1;transform:none}
/* variant B: cards fan in from the sides */
.hb.js .ojourney--fan .oj-row:nth-child(odd) .oj-card{transform:translateX(-40px)}
.hb.js .ojourney--fan .oj-row:nth-child(even) .oj-card{transform:translateX(40px)}
.hb.js .ojourney--fan .oj-row.in .oj-card{transform:none}
/* variant C: cards tilt up */
.hb.js .ojourney--tilt .oj-card{transform:perspective(700px) rotateX(12deg) translateY(24px);transform-origin:bottom}
.hb.js .ojourney--tilt .oj-row.in .oj-card{transform:none}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .hb .ojourney::before{left:26px}
  .hb .oj-row{grid-template-columns:52px 1fr;gap:14px}
  .hb .oj-node{grid-column:1;width:52px;height:52px}
  .hb .oj-row:nth-child(odd) .oj-card,.hb .oj-row:nth-child(even) .oj-card{grid-column:2;margin:0}
  .hb .oj-tag{position:static;display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
  .hb .carousel-wrap{padding:0 52px}
  .hb .tsc{min-width:100%;max-width:100%}
  .hb .tst-nav{width:36px;height:36px;font-size:12px}
  .hb .tst-prev{left:0}.hb .tst-next{right:0}
}

/* CTA kicker (legible on dark / gradient bands) */
.hb .cta-kick{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#EAFBF1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px;margin-bottom:16px}
.hb .cta-kick i{color:#9EE7B8}
.hb .cta-kick--solid{color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}

/* Journey shared close */
.hb .jloop{margin-top:34px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:center}
.hb .jloop .ic{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--forest);color:#7BE0A0;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:21px;animation:spin 9s linear infinite}
.hb .jloop p{max-width:60ch;color:var(--ink3);font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.hb .oj-apps{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-top:14px}
.hb .oj-apps .pchip{font-size:12px}.hb .oj-apps .pchip img{width:20px;height:20px}
.hb .oj-tag{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:6px}

/* Journey A · horizontal scroll filmstrip */
.hb .jfilm{display:flex;gap:0;overflow-x:auto;padding:44px 4px 24px;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:none;-ms-overflow-style:none}
.hb .jfilm::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.hb .jf-card{scroll-snap-align:center;flex:0 0 300px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line2);border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .jf-img{position:relative;height:150px}
.hb .jf-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.hb .jf-n{position:absolute;left:14px;top:14px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:15px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .jf-body{padding:20px 22px}
.hb .jf-body h4{font-size:18px;color:#000;margin-bottom:6px}
.hb .jf-body p{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink3);line-height:1.5}
.hb .jf-arrow{flex:0 0 46px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--green);font-size:20px}
.hb .jf-hint{text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}

/* Journey B · vertical alternating image rows on a centre line */
.hb .jvert{position:relative;margin-top:48px}
.hb .jvert::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--blue),var(--green));border-radius:3px}
.hb .jv-row{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 70px 1fr;align-items:center;margin-bottom:30px}
.hb .jv-dot{grid-column:2;justify-self:center;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:3px solid var(--green);color:var(--green-d);font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center;z-index:2;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hb .jv-media{border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);aspect-ratio:16/10}
.hb .jv-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}
.hb .jv-row:hover .jv-media img{transform:scale(1.06)}

(function(){

  if('IntersectionObserver' in window && !reduce){
    var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){show(e.target);io.unobserve(e.target);}});},{rootMargin:'0px 0px -8% 0px',threshold:.08});

    var done=false;
    var cio=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting && !done){done=true;
        var to=parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-to')),dec=(el.getAttribute('data-dec')||'0')|0,t0=null,dur=1400;
        (function tick(ts){if(!t0)t0=ts;var p=Math.min(1,(ts-t0)/dur);var v=to*(1-Math.pow(1-p,3));el.textContent=v.toFixed(dec);if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(tick);else el.textContent=to.toFixed(dec);})(performance.now());

  // Overall-journey filmstrip: gentle auto smooth-scroll, ping-pong, yields to the user
  if(!reduce){
    document.querySelectorAll('.jfilm').forEach(function(f){
      var dir=1, hover=false, resumeAt=0, last=performance.now();
      f.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){hover=true;});
      f.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){hover=false;});
      ['wheel','pointerdown','touchstart','keydown'].forEach(function(ev){f.addEventListener(ev,function(){resumeAt=performance.now()+3500;},{passive:true});});
      function step(ts){var dt=Math.min(64,ts-last); last=ts;
        var max=f.scrollWidth-f.clientWidth;

    }
    function startAuto(){if(autoTimer)clearInterval(autoTimer);autoTimer=setInterval(function(){go(page+1);},3000);}
    function pauseAuto(){clearInterval(autoTimer);clearTimeout(pauseTimer);pauseTimer=setTimeout(startAuto,6000);}
    if(prev)prev.addEventListener('click',function(){go(page-1);pauseAuto();});
    if(next)next.addEventListener('click',function(){go(page+1);pauseAuto();});
    dots.forEach(function(d){d.addEventListener('click',function(){go(parseInt(d.getAttribute('data-slide')));pauseAuto();});});
    wrap.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){clearInterval(autoTimer);});
    wrap.addEventListener('mouseleave',function(){startAuto();});
    startAuto();
  });
})();
</script>
